title: Terah's Family and Journey to Haran
description: Terah's family history is told: Haran dies in Ur of the Chaldeans, Abram marries Sarai who is barren, and Nahor marries Milcah. Terah takes Abram, Sarai, and Lot and leaves Ur for Canaan, but they settle in Haran, where Terah dies at 205 years old.
